question: Which collective domain encompasses all earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: They belong to a complete field-group
inference: The complete field-group comprises all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The exact technical meaning of sarvakṣetrakam depends on tantric context.
plain_english: The complete field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
